description: Render the AI Assistant promotional video with Remotion and send it to the user as a video in Telegram. Renders the 60-second 'Promo-Landscape' (1920x1080) or 'Promo-Portrait' (1080x1920) composition and optionally muxes the 60s music bed. Takes a minute or two. 'variant' defaults to landscape. Pass 'project_path' only if the promo-video project folder cannot be auto-detected.

variant.description: Optional. Orientation of the promo video: 'landscape' (1920x1080, default) or 'portrait' (1080x1920).

with_music.description: Optional. Whether to mux the music bed (audio/music-mix.mp3) into the final video. Defaults to true when the music file exists.

project_path.description: Optional. Absolute path to the promo-video project directory (the folder containing promo-video/package.json). Usually auto-detected; only needed when the project is not in a standard location.
